title: Toronto: Niagara Falls Night Tour, Boat, Journey, Dinner & Tower
includes: Pick-up from select hotels and central locations in downtown Toronto and Mississauga
Skip-the-line ticket for Journey Behind the Falls (optional)
Winter Festival of Lights tour (approximately November 16 - January 5, dates vary)
Exclusive tour of Illumination Tower where you can change the waterfall colours (optional)
Transportation in an air-conditioned mini-coach with a licensed English speaking tour guide
Skip-the-line ticket for the Hornblower Boat Cruise (Optional, Open around May 1 to November 30)
Fireworks display (approximately May 17 - October 14, dates vary)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an evening tour of the incredible Niagara Falls with convenient pick-up from Toronto, Mississauga, and Niagara Falls hotels. Travel in an air-conditioned minibus, guided by a licensed expert sharing historical insights and local tales.

Visit Niagara’s top attractions, the Hornblower boat cruise (summer) or Journey Behind the Falls (winter). These experiences bring you close to the majestic Canadian Horseshoe Falls.

Afterward, explore the falls and Clifton Hill at your own pace. Choose the basic tour for extra dining time, or opt for the all-inclusive package featuring a 3-course dinner overlooking the illuminated waterfalls.

The all-inclusive package also includes exclusive access to the Illumination Tower, where you can control the falls’ evening light displays. From May to October, enjoy a fireworks show; in winter, experience the enchanting Winter Festival of Lights.

The tour ends in Niagara Falls around 10:15 PM, and you will return to your starting point.
